content: Third, we can make use of the entity commonsense that can be learned as a continuous vector representation from a separate larger corpus BIBREF9 , BIBREF10 . In the example, if we know that the entities “Los Angeles Dodgers” and “New York Mets” are American baseball teams and “Jae Seo” is a baseball player associated with the teams, then we can use this information to generate more coherent summaries. We find that $76.0\%$ of the extracted linked entities are covered by the pre-trained vectors in our experimental data, proving our third observation.
